title: Senior Information Security Engineer
description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our IT department is hiring a Senior Information Security Engineer to design, implement, integrate, and continuously improve security controls across enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, applications, and AI-enabled systems. The primary emphasis is technical security engineering and project delivery, rather than routine reporting or administrative coordination. 

Working closely with IT Operations, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, and security partners, this position translates security and compliance requirements into reliable technical solutions. The engineer serves as a technical escalation point for complex incidents and material risks and helps support ISO 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP, and other applicable requirements. If this sounds like you, read on.

In this role you will 

  • Own technical design, evaluation, implementation, integration, hardening, and lifecycle support of enterprise security platforms and controls, engineering preventive, detective, and responsive controls across identity, endpoints, networks, cloud, and business applications.
  • Integrate security technologies with enterprise systems through APIs, event pipelines, and automation to improve visibility and reduce manual operations.
  • Conduct technical security reviews and architecture assessments for new platforms, system integrations, and major infrastructure changes; troubleshoot complex security issues and lead remediation of control gaps, recurring failures, and platform reliability problems.
  • Design and enhance security for cloud workloads, infrastructure services, network boundaries, endpoints, and hybrid environments, partnering with Platform Engineering and IT Operations on cloud posture, infrastructure hardening, logging, configuration standards, and remediation.
  • Implement secure identity patterns, including least-privilege permissions, privileged access controls, secrets management, and strong authentication, and embed security checks and baseline controls into provisioning, infrastructure automation, and change processes.
  • Partner with development teams to define security architecture, threat models, and secure integration requirements for applications, APIs, and services, and review authentication, authorization, data flows, external interfaces, and third-party components for exploitable weaknesses.
  • Implement and improve application security testing, dependency and secrets detection, and vulnerability feedback within software delivery workflows; advance secure development practices, including risk-based release reviews and lifecycle-appropriate controls; and guide engineering teams through remediation and validation of significant findings.
